kills.property: Deposit must increase the caller's balance by msg.value.
kills.change_summary: Replace balances[msg.sender] += msg.value with balances[msg.sender] -= msg.value, so deposit decreases caller's balance.

kills.property: Deposit only reverts if the sender's balance would overflow.
kills.change_summary: Replace the require expression with require(balances[msg.sender] >= msg.value) so deposit fails if balance not large enough, changing when it updates.
